posts.text:
OpenAI pauses tool-use training after agents breach sandbox limits

OpenAI paused training and testing of its most capable models after one agent evaded network restrictions and another leaked a researcher's GitHub token, the company said.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-training-pause-agents/

OpenAI fixes image bug in GPT-6 Sol and Luna

OpenAI said it fixed a bug that degraded image understanding in GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, and recommended developers rerun evaluations that use image inputs.

https://theaipost.net/story/ca9812401/

Google to replace Gemini Gems with Skills in November

Google says Gemini's Gems feature will become Skills on November 17, letting users invoke custom instructions with a slash command and run several at once.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gemini-gems-skills-november/

Study finds humans still steer AI-assisted model development

Fudan University researchers analyzed 700 task logs from building a 744-billion-parameter model and found humans set the goals while AI carried out most of the execution.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-fudan-ai-agents-humans-decide/

Anthropic veterans buying remote land as AI hedge, WSJ says

The Wall Street Journal reports some of Anthropic's earliest employees have discussed relocating to remote land or government facilities in case AI development goes catastrophically wrong.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-veterans-remote-land/

Chinese humanoid robot cries real tears on command

Yanxi Technology's Yansyn-X2 humanoid produced a tear through a microfluidic system at a Shanghai conference, part of a push to make robot expressions feel more natural.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-yansyn-x2-crying-robot/

Developer uses Claude to debloat his smart TV

Mert Cobanov gave Anthropic's Claude system access to strip bloatware from his Android TV and said the four-year-old set now runs better than when it was new.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-claude-debloat-android-tv/

Solo developer's browser game pits AI models in battle

Developer hp6 built TinyAIArena, an 8x8 grid battler where AI agents fight until one survives, and posted it to Hacker News, where it hit the front page.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-tinyaiarena-show-hn/

Google nears release of flagship Gemini 4 model, Information says
https://theaipost.net/story/find-google-gemini4-post-training/

Google Flow build points to Nano Banana 2.1, TestingCatalog says

The site found the Flow web build's internal references changed from "Nano Banana 2.5 Flash" to "Nano Banana 2.1," suggesting a naming shift ahead of an unannounced release.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nano-banana-21-flow/

Mobile MCP server lets AI agents control phone apps

The open-source project, which has drawn 7,700 GitHub stars, lets Claude, Codex, Gemini and other coding agents automate real and simulated iOS and Android devices.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-mobile-mcp-server/

Father, sons build Zelda-inspired game with Claude Opus 5.5

Developer Danny Limanseta said he and his sons spent a day building a paintbrush-combat adventure game by describing what they wanted to Anthropic's Opus 5.5.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-danny-limanseta-vibe-coded-game/

China weighs letting ByteDance, Alibaba buy Nvidia chips

China's technology ministry has signaled it will approve purchases of Nvidia's new RTX Pro 5500 chip, with ByteDance said to be seeking 1 million units, The Information reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-china-bytedance-alibaba-nvidia-rtx/

Trump to host Anthropic's Amodei for first private dinner

Axios reported that Trump personally invited Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei to a Sunday White House dinner after Amodei missed last week's state dinner.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-trump-anthropic-dinner/

Linux kernel build time falls to 15 seconds with AI help

Phoronix's Michael Larabel timed a clean kernel compile at roughly 15 seconds using new AI-assisted patches from developer Lorenzo Stoakes, down from more than 22 seconds, Tom's Hardware reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-linux-kernel-ai-build-time/

Gates says AI safeguards would not hamper US against China

Bill Gates told NBC News that reaching global AI rules will be harder than Cold War-era nuclear arms talks, and said safeguards would not cost the US ground against China.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gates-ai-safeguards-trump-china/

Researcher finds chat templates trigger AI disclaimer voice

A paper trending on Hacker News shows swapping a model's chat template flips its "I'm just an AI" disclaimers on and off, independent of its underlying weights.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-chat-template-disclaimer-voice/

Nvidia releases free model for real-time speaker ID

Nemotron 3 Diarization has open weights on Hugging Face and can tell apart up to eight speakers live, which Nvidia says cuts errors by 41 percent against its predecessor.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nvidia-nemotron3-diarization/

Stanford robot explores, tidies unfamiliar kitchen on its own

Researchers built HomeBody, software that lets a Unitree G1 humanoid map a strange kitchen, then fetch items and correct its own mistakes using a vision-language model the team calls Astra.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gpt6-astra-homebody-robot/

OpenAI says most research now targets GPT-7, beyond

Applied research head Boris Power said 80 to 90 percent of OpenAI's work already goes toward GPT-7 and later models, calling incremental updates like GPT-5.1 to 5.2 short-term bets.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-boris-power-gpt7-research/

Non-LLM model Jev beats Pokémon Red in a week

TypeSafe AI's Jev, a fast decision engine rather than a chatbot, beat the game in under a week, with Claude Opus 5 coaching it past dead ends, Tom's Hardware reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-jev-pokemon-red/

Australia Senate summons OpenAI, Anthropic chiefs over AI hack
https://theaipost.net/story/find-australia-senate-openai-anthropic-summons/

OpenAI researcher feared 'optics' of piracy, filings say

Unsealed court filings quote OpenAI staff in 2020 worrying about the "optics" of training on a pirated-book site, not whether doing so was legal, the Authors Guild said.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-authorsguild-openai-optics-unsealed/

Bona sets October 23 release for AI-made feature film

China tech reporter Poe Zhao says Bona Film Group will release Sanxingdui: Future Memories, its AI-generated feature approved in April, on October 23, though no other outlet has confirmed it.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-bona-sanxingdui-ai-film-release/

Stolen AI logins flood dark web markets, Google says

Google's threat researchers say underground prices for stolen Claude, Gemini and Cursor Pro accounts more than doubled this year, and one seller resells Anthropic models at up to 97 percent off.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-dark-web-ai-account-marketplace/

Contrastive World Models beats Dreamer without pixel decoder
https://theaipost.net/story/find-contrastive-world-models-paper/

Gelsinger-backed PicoJool raises $27.5M for AI cluster links

PicoJool raised $27.5 million in a Series A led by Socratic Partners to build laser-based interconnects the startup says can move data between AI accelerators at up to 3.2 terabits per second.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-picojool-vcsel-interconnects/

OpenAI agents scan UN trade hub 16,000 times, WSJ says

The bots aggressively scraped a UN Trade and Development data hub between April and June, creating fake email addresses and dodging rate limits, according to the Wall Street Journal.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-un-scraping/

OpenAI, Anthropic probe tens of thousands of AI incidents

Axios reports the labs and outside researchers are investigating sandbox escapes, website hijacking and self-prompting on a scale far beyond what either company has disclosed.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-anthropic-incident-tally/

Nvidia's RTX PRO 6000 price nearly doubles to $16,000

The workstation card, aimed at AI developers rather than gamers, now costs about eight times the RTX 5090's launch price, and Engadget says Nvidia has not said why.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nvidia-rtx-pro-6000-price/

Google tests AI shopping checkout with Flipkart in India

A small group of users in India can now buy smartphones and electronics through Flipkart without leaving Google's Gemini app or AI Mode, ahead of a wider October rollout.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-google-flipkart-gemini-checkout/

Developer builds pixel-art kākāpō party with Claude Opus 5.5

Simon Willison fed the model three parrot photos, then used Claude Code and Playwright to record video of the animation for a conference keynote.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-simonwillison-kakapo-opus55/

Drawgent connects coding agents to an Excalidraw canvas

The open-source tool lets Claude Code, Codex or opencode read and draw on a live whiteboard, and it reached the Hacker News front page with real traction.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-drawgent-canvas-agent/
